name: wafer-proc-sim
description: Physics-informed machine learning framework for SiC wafer process simulation. Covers the full semiconductor manufacturing pipeline: FEM dicing/grinding simulation, Gaussian process surrogates, TMCMC Bayesian calibration, equipment manufacturer models (ASML/TEL/Disco/Lasertec/Advantest), AI ASIC supply-chain analysis (Terafab/hyperscalers), and quantum computing device process models. Validated with 66 physics-constrained unit tests against peer-reviewed literature.

referencePublication.description: Primary methodology reference. TMCMC Bayesian identification of a Hamilton 5-species oral biofilm model with multiscale uncertainty propagation (0D ODE → 1D/2D reaction-diffusion PDE → 3D Abaqus FEM) via Dysbiotic Index mapping. The TMCMC calibration framework in wafer-proc-sim is adapted from this work.
